audience: freelancers and small businesses that keep their invoicing and bookkeeping in FastBill

useCases.title: Find overdue invoices and who owes them
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices by state and due date, with customer, totals and line items, so you can see what to chase.

useCases.title: Draft an invoice from a job
useCases.text: The AI finds or creates the customer and creates a draft invoice from line items. The invoice stays a draft and is not sent.

useCases.title: Finalize a checked draft
useCases.text: After you confirm the draft, the AI finalizes it so it gets an invoice number. A final invoice can no longer be edited in FastBill.

useCases.title: Record a payment
useCases.text: The AI marks a final invoice as paid with the payment date and method once the money has arrived.

useCases.title: Log billable time on a project
useCases.text: The AI lists your projects and books a time entry with customer, project and start time, and later reads the entries back.

useCases.title: Review last month's expenses and revenue
useCases.text: The AI lists the expense and revenue entries of a date range, so you can compare income and costs before the tax advisor asks.
